desc.zh: 先分配位数，再用可撤销的删位与后缀比较构造最大数。
desc.en: Allocate digits, remove smaller tails, and resolve merge ties by comparing suffixes.

complexity: O(S(m+n+k²)) time; O(m+n+k) auxiliary space, where S ≤ min(m,n,k)+1 is the number of feasible splits

concepts.name: Greedy digit deletion
concepts.description: Exchange smaller tails while deletion budget remains.

concepts.name: Suffix-aware merge
concepts.description: Resolve equal heads using the entire remaining suffix.
